stories.headline: Iran awaits US reply on plan to reopen Hormuz in two days; Brent falls toward $109

key_facts.fact: Indirect US-Iran talks mediated by Qatar in Doha ran into a third day on Sunday, November 1, with Qatar trying to negotiate the release of more than $6 billion in Iranian assets that could lead to the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz.
key_facts.excerpt: Indirect talks in Doha ran into a third day on Sunday with Qatar trying to negotiate the release of more than $6bn in Iranian assets, which could lead to the reopening of the strait of Hormuz and the restart of negotiations on Iran's nuclear programme.

key_facts.fact: Iran and Qatar proposed reopening the Strait of Hormuz within two days if the US meets Tehran's conditions; Gulf officials said they were 'braced for the worst' ahead of the US midterm elections on Tuesday.
key_facts.excerpt: Iran and Qatar propose reopening the Strait of Hormuz within two days if the US meets Tehran's conditions; IRNA · Tehran state media says no definitive outcome has been reached

key_facts.fact: US Vice-President JD Vance sent a letter to Iran's security chief, who called it a 'positive' shift; Tehran insists the strait stays closed until its conditions are met.
key_facts.excerpt: US Vice-President JD Vance has sent a letter to Iran's security chief in a reported effort to revive talks and avert further strikes. Tehran says it is awaiting Washington's response, while insisting the Strait of Hormuz will remain closed until its conditions are met.

key_facts.fact: Iran's Revolutionary Guard said a supertanker carrying more than 2 million barrels of oil struck a naval mine and caught fire on Friday, the third tanker it said exploded that day after using unauthorized routes; the claims were not independently verified.
key_facts.excerpt: Iran's Revolutionary Guard said Friday that a supertanker carrying more than 2 million barrels of oil struck a naval mine, exploded and caught fire while using an unauthorized route in the Strait of Hormuz... The Guard said it was the third oil tanker to explode Friday

key_facts.fact: Oil slid more than 3% on Monday as Trump signalled more time for Iran diplomacy after a 'tough' call with Netanyahu.
key_facts.excerpt: Oil prices slide more than 3% as Trump signals more time for Iran diplomacy - Trump has 'tough' call with Netanyahu and favours giving Iran negotiations more time

key_facts.fact: Brent had ended October at its highest level in six months; OPEC+ kept December production targets steady on Sunday, saying no further adjustments until next year.
key_facts.excerpt: Brent ended October at its highest level in six months... OPEC+, kept December production targets steady on Sunday, confirming expectations that more policy adjustments will not occur until next year

key_facts.fact: IMF PortWatch recorded only 2 transits through Hormuz on October 25, against a pre-crisis baseline of 85 per day.
key_facts.excerpt: IMF PortWatch recorded 2 transits on October 25, against a pre-crisis baseline of 85 per day

stories.headline: FBI blames North Korea's TraderTraitor for $6B Binance hack; $3.6B leaves as withdrawals resume

key_facts.fact: The FBI said on Saturday, October 31, that North Korea was responsible for the theft of more than $6 billion in virtual assets from Binance on or about October 29, activity it calls 'TraderTraitor'.
key_facts.excerpt: The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) is releasing information advising the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (North Korea) was responsible for the theft of more than $6 billion USD in virtual assets from cryptocurrency exchange Binance, on or about October 29, 2026.

key_facts.fact: The FBI, with the Secret Service and IRS-CI, urged node operators, DeFi services and exchanges to block transactions tied to listed laundering addresses, saying the hackers were converting stolen assets mainly into Ethereum.
key_facts.excerpt: The FBI, together with partners at the USSS and IRS-CI, has observed TraderTraitor actors converting stolen assets primarily into Ethereum (ETH).

key_facts.fact: TraderTraitor is the same group blamed for the $1.5 billion Bybit theft in February 2025.
key_facts.excerpt: TraderTraitor is the same group blamed for a $1.5 billion (€1.34bn) theft from the Bybit platform in February last year.

key_facts.fact: Binance began restoring withdrawals in phases on November 1; between 06:00 and 15:30 GMT it processed $4.649 billion in withdrawals and $1.01 billion in deposits, a net outflow of about $3.64 billion, or 2.1% of its $171 billion in assets.
key_facts.excerpt: Between 06:00 and 15:30 [GMT] on November 1, we processed $4.649 billion in withdrawals and $1.01 billion in deposits, resulting in a net outflow of approximately $3.64 billion.

key_facts.fact: CEO Richard Teng said Binance had replenished about 95% of the impacted assets and would absorb the losses; Circle froze more than $1.1 billion in USDC, per Reuters.
key_facts.excerpt: As withdrawals began, CEO Richard Teng said Binance had replenished approximately 95% of the affected assets... Reuters, which also reported that Circle had frozen more than $1.1 billion in USDC.

key_facts.fact: Chainalysis said the hackers moved more than $500 million on Tron through more than 1,000 addresses before bridging funds out to Ethereum, Bitcoin and Solana.
key_facts.excerpt: After the attack, the hackers moved more than $500 million on Tron through more than 1,000 addresses, over 3,000 deposits and several Tron-based DeFi protocols, blockchain analytics firm Chainalysis said on Sunday.

key_facts.fact: Binance said early checks suggest the breach may have started with a compromised engineer's laptop.
key_facts.excerpt: Binance said last week that early checks suggest the incident may have started with a compromised laptop that belonged to an engineer

stories.headline: Ukraine's air-raid app hacked with fake nuclear alerts; Russia reports similar hack hours later

key_facts.fact: On Sunday night, November 1, 122 fake alerts were issued across Ukraine between 22:47 and 22:54 Kyiv time, some warning of radiation, chemical attack and street fighting in the capital.
key_facts.excerpt: 122 fake alerts were issued across the country between 22:47 and 22:54 Kyiv time, most warning of incoming missiles or drones but some stating the threat included radiation, chemical attack, artillery shelling and fighting in the streets of the capital.

key_facts.fact: Ukraine's air force said the Air Alert app had probably been subjected to hostile interference and that there was no radiation threat; the government temporarily disabled the app.
key_facts.excerpt: "The Air Alarm application has probably been subjected to hostile interference. There is no radiation threat! Stay calm and follow our updates on our channel." The government said it had temporarily disabled the app for maintenance

key_facts.fact: A Russian-language message claimed Ukraine was under nuclear alert and that 'Oreshnik is in action', referencing a Telegram channel called Hitcorecorp; pro-Kremlin channel Mash said the group claimed responsibility, which NBC could not verify.
key_facts.excerpt: Another message professed, in Russian, that all of Ukraine was under nuclear alert. "Don't worry," it added. "Oreshnik is in action"... That message referenced a Telegram channel called Hitcorecorp.

key_facts.fact: Russia's Emergency Situations Ministry said its mobile app suffered a 'massive cyberattack' that let attackers send fake information, including alerts warning of nuclear warheads launched at Russia.
key_facts.excerpt: Russian authorities said Monday that hackers had sent fake emergency alerts after gaining access to the Russian Emergency Situations Ministry's mobile app

key_facts.fact: Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said Russian government resources are under constant cyberattack and that the spread of AI is contributing to an increase in attacks.
key_facts.excerpt: He said the proliferation of AI technology was contributing to an increase in cyberattacks.

key_facts.fact: The hacks came just as a rare humanitarian ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine ended.
key_facts.excerpt: The dueling accusations came just as a rare humanitarian ceasefire between the two sides ended, raising fears of intensified fighting rather than a move toward broader peace.

stories.headline: Suspected cyberattack overheats supermarket freezers in six European countries, echoing France

key_facts.fact: Overnight from Sunday to Monday, November 2, dozens of supermarkets in Belgium, Luxembourg, Sweden, Ireland, the Netherlands and Estonia had fridge and freezer temperatures spike in a suspected cyberattack.
key_facts.excerpt: Around 40 Delhaize supermarkets in Belgium and Luxembourg were affected, while a smaller number of shops were hit in Sweden, Ireland, the Netherlands and Estonia.

key_facts.fact: Sabcobel CEO Stephan Moelans said the units' evaporators were switched to defrost mode, the same mechanism as in last month's French attack, and that a software update alone cannot fix the vulnerability.
key_facts.excerpt: The refrigeration executive said a software update alone is not enough to address the vulnerability, with physical modifications required instead.

key_facts.fact: In Belgium, some 40 Delhaize, 15 Carrefour, 15 Intermarché and five Spar stores were reportedly hit; IKEA's Mons store was also affected.
key_facts.excerpt: Some 40 Delhaize Proxy supermarkets, 15 Carrefour Shop & Go stores, 15 Intermarché shops and five Spar Q8 service station locations have reportedly been impacted in Belgium

key_facts.fact: In Ireland, 13 of SuperValu's 223 stores were affected; Sweden's cybersecurity centre head John Billow said Sweden has many exposed operational-technology devices that need patching.
key_facts.excerpt: "We have in recent weeks … identified that we have quite a lot of exposed operational technology devices in Sweden that we have been clear about the necessity to update or patch," he said.

key_facts.fact: Last month's French attack hit hundreds of supermarkets, pushing temperatures as high as 50C (122F) and causing fires and food losses; no one has claimed responsibility.
key_facts.excerpt: police said hackers seized control of cooling units at hundreds of supermarkets, raising temperatures as high as 122 degrees Fahrenheit and causing fires and food losses... There were no claims of responsibility.

key_facts.fact: Danfoss said the cooling systems of at least 17 companies in the Netherlands were attacked overnight.
key_facts.excerpt: In the Netherlands, the freezing and cooling systems of at least seventeen companies were attacked last night, according to a spokesperson for supplier Danfoss.

stories.headline: South Korea's Lee pitches record $610B budget, nearly doubling AI spending to $16B

key_facts.fact: In a budget speech to the National Assembly on Monday, November 2, President Lee Jae Myung outlined an 820.9 trillion won (~$610 billion) spending plan for 2027, up 12.8%, the fastest annual increase on record.
key_facts.excerpt: Lee outlined an 820.9 trillion won ($610 billion) spending plan for 2027, up 12.8 percent from this year, the fastest annual increase and largest fiscal outlay in South Korea's history.

key_facts.fact: Lee said the government will invest 21.3 trillion won (US$15.97 billion), nearly twice this year's amount, in AI and three megaprojects: semiconductors, physical AI and AI data centres.
key_facts.excerpt: "We will invest 21.3 trillion won (US$15.97 billion), nearly twice this year's amount, in AI and the three megaprojects of semiconductors, physical AI and AI data centres," Lee said.

key_facts.fact: The budget earmarks 4.7 trillion won for homegrown frontier AI models, 2 trillion won for chip production capacity and 500 billion won for physical AI trials.
key_facts.excerpt: The proposal earmarks 2 trillion won to expand semiconductor production capacity... Another 4.7 trillion won will support frontier AI development... 500 billion won for physical AI trials

key_facts.fact: The spending jump is financed by higher tax revenue from record profits at Samsung Electronics and SK hynix amid the AI chip boom, partly via a new Future Fund.
key_facts.excerpt: The sharp increase in the 2027 budget was made possible by expectations of higher tax revenue amid record high profits at semiconductor giants, including Samsung Electronics Co. and SK hynix Inc., fueled by the AI boom

key_facts.fact: Defense spending rises 8.2% to 73.3 trillion won, including nuclear-powered submarines and KF-21 fighters, as Seoul seeks wartime operational control from the US within Lee's term.
key_facts.excerpt: Defense expansion is another standout feature of the 2027 spending plan, with the budget rising 8.2 percent to 73.3 trillion won as the Lee administration seeks to complete the transfer of wartime operational control (OPCON)

key_facts.fact: Lee asked lawmakers to pass the budget by the December 2 statutory deadline; the opposition People Power Party has questioned the Future Response Fund.
key_facts.excerpt: The main opposition People Power Party has questioned its fiscal implications and urged the government to use more of the windfall to reduce national debt.

stories.headline: SpaceX in talks to buy EchoStar's Boost Mobile or use its network after big carriers refused

key_facts.fact: SpaceX is in talks to buy Boost Mobile or use its network, the Washington Post reported on November 2, after Verizon, T-Mobile and AT&T all rejected Musk's requests for network access.
key_facts.excerpt: SpaceX is in talks to buy Boost Mobile or use its network, giving Musk a potential back door into the $235 billion wireless market... Ultimately, Verizon, T-Mobile and AT&T all told SpaceX no.

key_facts.fact: Musk personally met EchoStar chairman Charlie Ergen last month; EchoStar had 7.38 million wireless subscribers at the end of the second quarter.
key_facts.excerpt: EchoStar had 7.38 million wireless subscribers at the end of the second quarter... Musk has discussed the deal personally, meeting with EchoStar chairman Charlie Ergen last month

key_facts.fact: A deal may need consent from AT&T and T-Mobile, since Boost's network-leasing agreements may not transfer to a new owner without the carriers' approval.
key_facts.excerpt: The proposed service may need consent from AT&T and T-Mobile, as Boost Mobile's existing network-leasing agreements may not be transferable to a new owner without the carriers' approval

key_facts.fact: EchoStar shares rose about 4% and SpaceX 2.8% in premarket trading; SpaceX's CFO has said the company aims to 'become a major mobile carrier' in the US and it agreed in October to buy $8 billion in spectrum.
key_facts.excerpt: EchoStar shares rose 4% in premarket trading by 06:07 ET, while SpaceX gained 2.8%... Chief Financial Officer Bret Johnsen said the company aims to "become a major mobile carrier ... in the United States." SpaceX earlier this month agreed to buy $8 billion of wireless spectrum licenses.

key_facts.fact: The move supports Starlink Mobile, a hybrid satellite-terrestrial network built on more than 12,000 satellites to compete with AT&T, Verizon and T-Mobile.
key_facts.excerpt: The talks fit SpaceX's push to build a hybrid satellite-terrestrial network through Starlink Mobile, combining its constellation of more than 12,000 satellites with ground-based infrastructure

stories.headline: FDA grants accelerated approval to Inovio's Voceryq, the first DNA-based immunotherapy in the US

key_facts.fact: On October 30, the FDA granted accelerated approval to Inovio's Voceryq for adults with recurrent respiratory papillomatosis (RRP), a rare HPV-caused disease that forms wart-like growths in the airways.
key_facts.excerpt: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration today granted accelerated approval for Voceryq (doruxapapogene ralaplasmid and lalikinogene sifuplasmid-gxfd) for treatment of adults with recurrent respiratory papillomatosis (RRP)

key_facts.fact: The FDA called it the first plasmid DNA-based immunotherapy approved in the US; Inovio says it is the first FDA-approved DNA medicine.
key_facts.excerpt: VOCERYQ represents the first U.S. FDA approved DNA medicine, validating INOVIO's novel platform technology

key_facts.fact: The therapy targets HPV-6 and HPV-11 and is indicated to reduce the frequency of surgery; in the efficacy group, 7 of 26 patients needed no surgery in the first year.
key_facts.excerpt: In the efficacy group, 7 of 26 patients had no surgery in the first year. Confirmatory evidence is still required.

key_facts.fact: Inovio expects Voceryq to be available to order in about 60 days, with full commercial launch in Q1 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: INOVIO expects to make VOCERYQ available to order and ship in approximately 60 days, with full commercial launch in the first quarter of 2027

key_facts.fact: Continued approval depends on confirmatory trials; the FDA had granted the therapy Breakthrough and Orphan Drug designations.
key_facts.excerpt: The manufacturer must conduct post-approval clinical trials to verify and describe Voceryq's clinical benefit. The FDA granted Voceryq Breakthrough and Orphan Drug designations.
